system.description:
Cursed item (seems a Unique long sword +1; the GM rolls a power for it to show, which never works). It is a long sword +1.

  • When a creature damages you, make a Will save or attack only that creature until it or you drop.
  • Repeat the save at the end of each of your turns.

Monsters & Treasure, Cursed Items.

  • Identify shows only what it seems; once the curse shows, it can't be put down or taken off until Remove Curse frees the user, and the item stays cursed.
  • Valued as the item it imitates.
  • Save DC 15 unless the entry says otherwise.
